basic_info.description: Fabulous three-bedroom, two-bath updated home with the winning combination of mid-century design, warmth, fine details and located in a fantastic Bernal Heights location! The inviting main level of the home presents an open floor plan with a large living/dining area, fireplace, gorgeous wood floors and a gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances all awash with plenty of natural light. There are two spacious bedrooms on this same level that overlook the backyard/garden/patio and a tastefully refreshed bathroom with skylight. The master bedroom is ideally located on the lower level with a modern en-suite bathroom and direct access to the backyard/garden/patio. The large and flat backyard/garden/patio offers mature grounds and flowering garden space providing the ideal ambiance for entertainment, a gardener's paradise, or a serene and tranquil space for peaceful repose. A large garage with an artist studio/workout room, solar system, and plenty of room for storage add the final touches to this special home that is close to restaurants, shopping, cafes, playgrounds, public transportation, HWY 101/280 and more!
